messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: RATE_LIMITER_HEARTBEAT_MISS for service=prod-api, severity=P1, incident_id=RL-2026-0314
pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert RL-2026-0314 assigned to alice (oncall) — notify: phone/sms/push
alice: acked. I'm on it. Looking into rate limiter health.
carlos: seeing spike in `limiter.errors` + `quota.apply` failures, looks like heartbeat to quota-store timed out ~ 00:05 UTC. Metrics: 90% increase in 429s across edge tier.
meera: confirmed telemetry — redis kv-store latency spiked to 800ms, heartbeats to allocator timed out. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/rate-limiter?range=15m
jon: customer-impact: several customers reported elevated 429s on hosted API; some requests degraded to fallback which increased latency. No major data loss reported yet. Engaging CS for high-touch customers.
carlos: dumping recent logs from limiter:```
2026-03-14T00:04:12Z ERROR quota_allocator.go:142 failed heartbeat to kv-store: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-14T00:04:13Z WARN rate_limiter.go:301 applyQuota failed, returning 429 to requester
2026-03-14T00:05:01Z ERROR metrics_emitter.go:88 emit failed: redis: connection reset by peer
```
alice: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable strict quota enforcement (fall back to soft limit) 2) scale up fallback pool + route non-critical traffic to degraded mode 3) pagerduty escalation if can't restore in 15m. Carol, can you run the disable?
carlos: running the feature-flag toggle now: `./ffctl set quota.strict_enforcement false --env prod --who alice` — applying...
ops-bot: Feature-flag change applied: quota.strict_enforcement=false (actor=carlos)
meera: provisioning emergency capacity for kv-store and opening a dedicated connection pool. Starting `redis-restart-lite` on cluster shard-4 to restore heartbeats. ETA ~6m.
alice: updated PD: mitigations started, traffic should start improving once KV heartbeats recover. I'll keep this thread as primary incident channel.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert RL-2026-0314 acknowledged by alice; escalation timer paused.
jon: pinging top 5 affected accounts, letting them know we're mitigating; will escalate to account execs if any SLA breaches.
carlos: quick check: limiter process showed C10 CPU spike then OOM-kill on worker-3 around 00:05. Restarted worker and reattached cache. Looking at crash logs now.
alice: thanks. If kv-store doesn't recover in 10m we will open temporary bypass and revert to best-effort routing.
meera: redis shard restart completed, heartbeats resumed. latency back to ~35ms. Metrics: 429 rate down 70% in past 4m.
jon: customer update: sent holding note to affected customers, flagged high touch for two enterprise customers.
carlos: confirmed restart fixed OOM cause — bad GC pause due to a leaked iterator in allocator. Patch queued, will cherry-pick to prod in a canary.
alice: scaling down emergency capacity; keeping soft quota for now until patch ships. PD: marking as mitigated, not resolved.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident RL-2026-0314 status changed to MITIGATED by alice.
ops-bot: incident timeline logged to opsdb: RL-2026-0314 (mitigated)
alice: handing off to meera for overnight follow-up and postmortem. I will create the incident doc after handoff. @meera you're on for postmortem + RCA.
meera: taking handoff. I'll coordinate the cherry-pick, tighten alerts for heartbeat latency, and run a runbook update to avoid silent OOM restarts.
jon: closing loop with CS: customers acknowledged update and limited impact. No urgent credits requested at this time.
alice: thanks all — please add any follow-ups to the postmortem.
meera: noted. Follow-ups: add circuit-breaker in allocator, increase heartbeat retries, add an automated fallback route when kv-store health < 70%.
carlos: will prepare the patch and a safe rollout plan (canary + 10% ramp).
incident-bot: This thread will be archived to incidents channel after PM created.
